[{"signature":"zoi.event_host_valid(zoi.event_host_allocations)","definition_hash":"06ff045cd0f87ca67b5d1e6dec067a35","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.event_host_valid(a zoi.event_host_allocations)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$SELECT a.status='active' AND a.expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM zoi.event_table_settings s WHERE s.event_id=a.event_id AND s.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND s.version=a.pricing_version AND zoi.table_inventory_public(a.event_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.venue_tables_zones t JOIN public.event_venues v ON v.id=t.venue_id WHERE t.id=a.table_id AND t.capacity>=a.quota AND v.event_id=a.event_id AND v.workspace_id=a.workspace_id))$function$\n"},{"signature":"zoi.suite_current_session()","definition_hash":"8ceef7877aeb972d09d8694f6c85dff7","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.suite_current_session()\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare sid text:=auth.jwt()->>'session_id';\nbegin\n if auth.uid() is null or coalesce(sid,'') !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$' then raise exception 'suite_session_unavailable' using errcode='42501';end if;\n perform 1 from auth.users where id=auth.uid() and deleted_at is null and coalesce(is_anonymous,false)=false and (banned_until is null or banned_until<=clock_timestamp());\n if not found then raise exception 'suite_session_unavailable' using errcode='42501';end if;\n perform 1 from auth.sessions where id=sid::uuid and user_id=auth.uid() and (not_after is null or not_after>clock_timestamp());\n if not found then raise exception 'suite_session_unavailable' using errcode='42501';end if;\nend $function$\n"}]
